title: The Hoop
subtitle: A diamond hoop presents its light as one continuous arc rather than as individual stones — the line is the design. The Custom Hoop is built to a specific diameter and stone count, each stone calibrated to the geometry of the arc so the result reads as a single unbroken surface of diamond rather than a sequence of individual mounts. Made to order in Los Angeles.
